title: Hayati Pro Max Blueberry Raspberry Lemon Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Blueberry Raspberry Lemon combines sweet and sharp in a vivid three-part fruit blend. Blueberry delivers a rich, jammy sweetness, Raspberry adds a ruby-red tartness, and Lemon cuts through with a bright, citrusy kick that sharpens the overall profile. The result is a bold and zesty vape that’s a must-try for fans of unique fruit blends. Made with nicotine salts for a smoother throat hit and faster nicotine absorption, this e-liquid is tailored for MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices such as starter kits and pod systems. Its 50VG/50PG formula ensures consistent vapour production and dependable flavour delivery. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
